title: End-of-Book Statement in Glossary

illustrates.quote: In the final volume include a centered end-of-book statement enclosed in transcriber's note indicators: The End.

blocks.features: No print excerpt is given in the source for this example -- only a boxed braille-only excerpt is shown, illustrating braille page-layout mechanics (where the end-of-volume/end-of-book statement falls), confirmed against the PDF page image.

braille.notes: Braille page lines 20-25, verbatim. resolution: Both runs agree on the braille content verbatim and that no print excerpt is given.
